Made supervising censor, he impeached Heshilie Zhizhong, Western Capital commander, for corruption; the Prince of Weishao ignored him and sent him to Zhaozhou as defense commissioner.
紇石烈 is the clan name Heshilie (石 shi); 衛紹王 is the Prince of Weishao, not an emperor; 肇州 is Zhaozhou.

紇石烈 is the clan name Heshilie (石 shi); 衛紹王 is the Prince of Weishao, not an emperor; 肇州 is Zhaozhou.

He was posthumously awarded Defender-General of the State and Military Commissioner of the Shunyi Army.
贈 is a posthumous award of rank and office, not an enfeoffment.

In the second year of Zhenyou he was made associate military commissioner of the Xi'an Army, then served as associate prefect of Lintao and Pingliang and as defense commissioner of Hezhou.
臨洮 is Lintao, not Linzhou.

Early in Xingding, Pacification Commissioner Puxian Wannu harbored disloyal ambitions and wished to abandon Xianping for the Yilan Route. Chisheng strenuously opposed him; Wannu was furious and had him beaten eighty strokes.

Early in Xingding, Pacification Commissioner Puxian Wannu harbored disloyal ambitions and wished to abandon Xianping for the Helan Route. Chisheng strenuously opposed him; Wannu was furious and had him beaten eighty strokes.
曷懶路 is the Helan (Hela) Route, not Yilan.

Chisheng joined Detachment Controller and Xianping Administrative Aide Puman Saibu and Wanhu Han Gongshu in a plot to kill Taiping, restore Chengchong to direct regional affairs, and attack Wannu together.

Chisheng joined Detachment Controller and Xianping Administrative Aide Peiman Saibu and Wanhu Han Gongshu in a plot to kill Taiping, restore Chengchong to direct regional affairs, and attack Wannu together.
裴滿 is the Jurchen clan name Peiman (裴 pei).

In the second year of Zhenyou he was transferred to associate military commissioner of the Xi'an Army, then served successively as associate prefect of Linzhou and Pingliang and as defense commissioner of Hezhou.

In the second year of Zhenyou he was transferred to associate military commissioner of the Xi'an Army, then served successively as associate prefect of Lintao and Pingliang and as defense commissioner of Hezhou.
臨洮 is Lintao, not Linzhou.

At the beginning of Xingding the Pacification Commissioner Puxian Wannu harbored a different intent and wished to abandon Xianping and move to the Yilan Route; Chisheng strenuously stopped him; Wannu was angry and had him beaten eighty strokes.

At the beginning of Xingding the Pacification Commissioner Puxian Wannu harbored a different intent and wished to abandon Xianping and move to the Helan Route; Chisheng strenuously stopped him; Wannu was angry and had him beaten eighty strokes.
曷懶路 is the Helan (Hela) Route, not Yilan.

裴滿 is the Jurchen clan name Peiman (裴 pei).

Liang Chisheng, style name Jingfu, was born Xunyi and changed his name because it resembled Emperor Xuanzong's personal name.
嫌名 means a name merely resembling the sovereign's, not his actual name; the change was made because 詢 sounded like Xuanzong's personal name.

He was posthumously made General of the Dragon-Tiger Guard and commander-in-chief of Posu troops and horses; his nephew Heisi was made his heir and specially granted four offices.
婆速 is read Posu (婆 po), the Posu circuit.
Before long he escaped with his family, was made associate prefect of Linzhou, moved to Qingyang, and was promoted to military commissioner of the Baoda Army.
Before long he escaped with his family, was made associate prefect of Lintao, moved to Qingyang, and was promoted to military commissioner of the Baoda Army.
臨洮 is Lintao, not Linzhou.
An edict ordered the Xuzhou and Guixing monasteries to round them up and release them.
An edict ordered the Xuzhou and Guide branch Bureaus of Military Affairs to round them up and release them.
徐州、歸德行院 are the branch Bureaus of Military Affairs (行院) at Xuzhou and Guide, not monasteries; 歸德 is Guide.
He was made concurrent superintendent of the Wannigong.
He was made concurrent superintendent of the Wanning Palace.
萬甯宮 is the Wanning Palace; 同提舉 is its co-superintendent.

He personally led the remaining troops out daily to fight. The Song burned their camp and withdrew. Heshou was wounded and could not ride; he sent Pacification Deputy Commissioner Zhuhu Yilada in pursuit, who killed several tens of men and recovered the captives.
朮虎 is the Jurchen clan name Zhuhu (朮 zhu), and 移剌答 is a single given name Yilada.
紇石烈 is conventionally read Heshilie.

Before long he brought his family and escaped back; he was appointed associate prefect of Lintao, moved to Qingyang, and promoted to Military Commissioner of the Baoda Army.

He was changed to concurrent superintendent of the Wanning Palace.
萬甯宮 is the Wanning Palace; 同提舉 is its co-superintendent.

After a long time he was given an honorary post as associate prefect of Lintao and served concurrently as prefect of Dingxi.

After a long time he was remotely commissioned associate prefect of Lintao and concurrent prefect of Dingxi.

按出虎割里罕 is read Anchuhu Gelihan (按 an, 罕 han).

He was made Great General of Shining Resolution, given an honorary post as defense commissioner of Mengzhou and concurrent prefect, while keeping his supervisor and pacification posts.
